user.title: Set up Simple Smart Cover
user.description: Set up smart cover control based on weather and sun position.

duplicate_select.title: Copy group
duplicate_select.description: Select the existing group whose settings should be copied.

duplicate_configure.title: Configure copied group
duplicate_configure.description: Adjust name, covers and orientation for the copy of group "{source_name}". {warning}

create_new.title: Create new group — Basics
create_new.description: Name the group and select the covers and weather entity to use for control.

data_description.name: Name of the cover group. The entity ID is derived from this.
data_description.covers: All covers that should be controlled together.
data_description.weather_entity: Home Assistant weather entity for current conditions and temperature.
data_description.save_and_exit: Check to save the configuration at this point and exit the dialog without going through the remaining steps.

create_schedule.title: Schedule
create_schedule.description: Set when covers open in the morning, close in the evening, and the quiet period (no movement).

data_description.morning_time: Morning open time. If this falls inside the quiet window it is automatically shifted to the end of quiet time.
data_description.enable_morning: Enables the morning trigger that opens the covers at the configured time.
data_description.enable_evening: Enables the sunset trigger that moves the covers to the evening position.
data_description.enable_quiet_mode: During quiet time no movements are executed.
data_description.save_and_exit: Check to save the configuration at this point and exit the dialog without going through the remaining steps.

create_sun_temp.title: Sun & Temperature
create_sun_temp.description: Configure window orientation and temperature logic. These values determine when the sun counts as 'in the window' and above which temperature shading is applied.

data_description.window_orientation: Compass direction of the window in degrees: 0 = North, 90 = East, 180 = South, 270 = West.
data_description.sun_angle_tolerance: Angular range left and right of the window direction where the sun counts as 'in the window'.
data_description.min_sun_elevation: Minimum sun height above the horizon. Below this no shading is applied (e.g. winter).
data_description.temp_threshold: Above this temperature it is considered warm and the sun-protection position is used.
data_description.temp_source: Optional temperature sensor. If not set, the weather entity temperature is used.
data_description.use_forecast_max_temp: ENABLED: the integration calculates when the sun will hit the window today and uses the predicted temperature and weather condition at that time — instead of the current sun position. This allows a single morning decision for the whole day, even without periodic re-evaluation. Falls back to the daily max temperature if the hourly forecast is unavailable.
data_description.temp_forecast_entity: Optional sensor for today's maximum temperature. Only used if the hourly forecast at the calculated sun-in-window time is unavailable.
data_description.cloudy_conditions: Weather conditions under which the covers should open.
data_description.save_and_exit: Check to save the configuration at this point and exit the dialog without going through the remaining steps.

create_positions.title: Positions
create_positions.description: Set the target positions for different situations (sun shading, cloudy, evening).

data.position_sunny_in_angle: Position for sun in angle & warm
data.position_sunny_outside_angle: Position for sun outside or too cold

data_description.position_sunny_in_angle: Target position when the sun shines into the window and it is warm.
data_description.position_sunny_outside_angle: Target position when the sun is not directly in the window or it is too cold.
data_description.invert_positions: Swaps the meaning of positions: 0% = down, 100% = up.
data_description.save_and_exit: Check to save the configuration at this point and exit the dialog without going through the remaining steps.

create_behavior.title: Behavior
create_behavior.description: Configure the re-evaluation interval, manual operation pause, presence-based extension and test mode.

data_description.enable_reevaluation: Periodically recalculate the target position, not just morning/evening.
data_description.min_position_change: Minimum difference from the current position before a movement is triggered.
data_description.enable_manual_activity_pause: After manual operation the automation is paused briefly.
data_description.manual_activity_duration: Duration of the pause after manual operation in minutes.
data_description.presence_sensor: Optional binary sensor (e.g. motion or presence detector). Once a manual pause is active, presence keeps it sticky and extends it by the value below (cooldown).
data_description.presence_pause_extension: Cooldown in minutes after the presence sensor reports 'off'. 0 = no cooldown, sticky only while presence is active.
data_description.test_mode: Active: calculations run but the covers do not move.
